quickerip.name: Quicker IP
quickerip.subtitle: Network toolkit for macOS
quickerip.tagline: Catch network problems before they catch you out.
features: IP presets and Network Locations - switch configs in one click
Live speed, SSID, and system info in the menu bar
LAN scanner, ping, and Dante network readiness

labassistant.name: Lab Assistant
labassistant.subtitle: QLab workspace automation for macOS
labassistant.tagline: Let the assistant prep the cues. You run the show.
features: LUFS normalisation and automatic level setting
Mono routing, silence trimming, and cue numbering
BPM and key detection with Camelot reordering

ewp.name: EWP
ewp.subtitle: Elevated Work Platform
ewp.tagline: Set up your screens once. Snap into any layout instantly.
features: Spotter panel - drag apps in, EWP arranges them instantly
Lift and Drop - raise your layout or clear the desktop in one click

fetchpuppy.name: Fetch Puppy
fetchpuppy.subtitle: Find and save music and video for your projects
fetchpuppy.tagline: Find, save, and convert media for any project.
features: Search and save from YouTube with smart quality scoring
Drag in a Spotify or Apple Music playlist - find every track automatically
Save videos from TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Reddit and more
